title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Iowa on 1971-03-20
lineage: SBD > MR > cass > DAT > CD > EAC > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Tight ’71 sound‑board capture with a hot Good Lovin’, Truckin’ and Around & Around, though the vocal mix is a bit muddy.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard tape that preserves a tight, high‑energy performance. Reviewers rave about the fire in Good Lovin’, the driving Truckin’/Hard to Handle/Loser sequence and an epic Around & Around, while noting that the vocals are occasionally off‑key or distorted and the mix could use a tweak. Overall the show shines thanks to Jerry’s ecstatic playing and a strong “pig” presence.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4‑5) and many praises of the musical performance outweigh the recurring but minor complaints about vocal mix, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard capture; board sounds great to most listeners. Vocal frequencies can become distorted or muddy at high levels and the overall mix is reported as uneven, but instrument separation remains solid.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid, well‑balanced set with a classic ’71 vibe; a few reviewers note duplicate tracks in the archive listing but the musical flow remains tight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar is loud, sweet and clearly enjoying the night; many cite his tone as a highlight that carries the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocal interjections are mentioned as occasionally clashing with Jerry’s lead, but no specific criticism of his playing.
